items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I mean a lot of musicians, Martin Williams just pointed out to me, think that you're somebody -- you're in your 40's.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, he wasn't playing too much.

Why is it that you are able to -- you know, to sound so young and to play so young? I mean a lot of musicians, Martin Williams just pointed out to me, think that you're somebody -- you're in your 40's.
